class_guess: Binary counter at the left wall eats a 6-cell reservoir; each overflow fossilizes the counter's binary residue as junk that the next cycle re-reads
summary: Left-wall binary counter eats a 010001 reservoir; overflow leaves a binary-residue junk word; spurts are residue-timed
mechanism: Counter pass (rules P0/P1, 80/80): 0^inf <D (011)^a (010001)^b x (010001)^c, x = one-cell phase defect. One pass moves the defect 2^a words right and adds a digit: (a,b,c) -> (a+1, b+2^a, c-2^a) while c >= 2^a.

Overflow (rule O, 24/24): when c < 2^a the whole sea is re-laid as a 3-cell field, 0^inf J (011)^(2b+2c) C>, where J is a junk word of exactly 3a+4 cells (the counter's partial state, i.e. a binary residue). Halting needs A to read 1 with a 1 on its right (A1 -> 0RF, F1 undefined). No halt to 2e10 (span 75,979, 36,061 ones).

Cycle: J (101)^n B> -> J' (101)^n' B> (n' - n = +28..+72 at the 34k level) or a spurt that doubles the field, 1 0^3 (011)^(2n+12..24) C>. J is the previous counter's residue (c0 + 2^a0) mod 2^A, and it decides which: plateaus of 1, 1, 9, 3 and 31 cycles, spurts at 1.1e7, 3.0e7, 3.3e8, 9.9e8, 1.88e10.

template.note: W4-3 (ours, killed) is a multi-level counter on 00/11 defects whose fossils are inert (block lengths only matter mod 4). Here the counter's leftover is fossilized as junk J and is re-read: J decides the next cycle's start and whether it spurts. W4-3's RIncs-style scan does not cover a junk word that carries a binary residue. SOMDC_Class1 shares the d = 4 distance only; its rule set (one structural counter) has no overflow-to-junk step.

strategy: A proof needs a closed description of the junk words J and the cycle map (J, n) -> (J', n') or spurt, for every reachable J. That is an arithmetic map on n and a binary residue (c0 + 2^a0) mod 2^A, with the spurt as one residue class. Parked unless that map turns out to be a clean binary rule.
risks: Residue-driven: the cycle outcome depends on a ~12-bit residue of a slowly growing n; plateau lengths 1, 1, 9, 3, 31 look irregular (possible Collatz-like map).
The junk J and the junk-processing phase (several sweeps with right records before each counter starts) are not characterised.
Waves 4 and 5 rejected it; the only fixed-constant rule rulefit found (E1(2n,632-n)) is one finite pass of rule P.
